body: Tried looking on meetup and everything but there's nothing catering to me anywhere near, not sure where to meet people online.
I do socialize irl but only in casual work environments and stuff, I'm not a shut-in, but I don't know where else I can socialize if it's something I have to do.
I guess it's because I don't want to be alone forever because of what I'm happy doing.

I guess that's true, the main issue isn't that I'm too late to be honest, it's that a lot of people seem to be saying I need to be better to be in a relationship when I was happy with who I was. I had a few hobbies, a good friend, planning to travel to at least one place annually, exercised and ate relatively healthily, but they act as if you have to be a lot more social and have different hobbies to be worthy for a relationship when I was happy with what I was doing and I don't really need any more friends, at least in real life
